cards.title: Spoon Ferry Dock-to-Deck Binder Clip Bridge

cards.adultSetup: Adult: place this paper card beside a pretend harbor sketch and invite one invented moment before the ferry moves on: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write the clue that helps the spoon ferry glide from the dock moment to the next gentle harbor job: ____________________.
cards.beforeMomentPrompt: Before moment: the spoon ferry pauses beside the cracker dock while the harbor helper notices ____________________.
cards.afterMomentPrompt: After moment: the next scene begins on the napkin-tide deck when the helper decides to ____________________.

cards.placeShiftPrompt: Place shift: show the pretend harbor changing from cracker dock to napkin-tide deck by adding ____________________.

cards.transitionQuestionPrompt: Transition question: what does the ferry helper notice that makes the next harbor moment make sense? ____________________.

cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: draw the dock on one side, the deck on the other, and write one bridge word: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: invent another spoon ferry transition that carries one harbor object into a new moment: ____________________.

cards.title: Acorn Avenue Slip-to-Seed Transition Clip

cards.adultSetup: Adult: set out the card with two invented acorn slips and ask which paper clue should lead the story onward: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write how the leaf clerk moves from the mixed slips to one clear next action at the seed counter: ____________________.
cards.beforeMomentPrompt: Before moment: two pretend acorn slips sit in the wrong twig tray because ____________________.
cards.afterMomentPrompt: After moment: the leaf clerk begins the next scene by matching one slip with ____________________.
cards.bridgeWordPrompt: Bridge word: choose a connecting word that shows the task changing from mixed to sorted: ____________________.
cards.characterMovePrompt: Character move: the clerk moves the story forward by clipping, turning, or comparing ____________________.
cards.placeShiftPrompt: Place shift: move the scene from the twig tray to the seed counter by showing ____________________.
cards.objectCarryPrompt: Object carry-over: the binder clip carries one seed tag, leaf mark, or tiny stamp into the next moment: ____________________.
cards.transitionQuestionPrompt: Transition question: what clue tells the clerk where the next pretend slip should go? ____________________.
cards.reviseTransitionPrompt: Revise transition: make the slip-to-seed shift clearer by changing one invented mark on the paper slip: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: draw two slips, clip one to a seed tag, and add one transition word: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: create another acorn office transition with invented slips and no actual errands: ____________________.

cards.kidDirection: Write the transition that moves the seed keeper from the folded map to the shelf card without naming an actual place: ____________________.
cards.beforeMomentPrompt: Before moment: the seed keeper unfolds a map corner and finds a tiny bean symbol beside ____________________.
cards.afterMomentPrompt: After moment: the next scene starts at the shelf card when the keeper realizes the symbol points to ____________________.
cards.bridgeWordPrompt: Bridge word: choose one connector that turns the map clue into the shelf-card moment: ____________________.
cards.characterMovePrompt: Character move: the keeper carries the story forward by lining up the symbol with ____________________.
cards.placeShiftPrompt: Place shift: show the scene moving from map table to seed shelf by adding ____________________.
cards.objectCarryPrompt: Object carry-over: the binder clip keeps the map flap, seed packet, or catalog card connected to ____________________.
cards.transitionQuestionPrompt: Transition question: which shelf detail makes the folded map clue useful in the next moment? ____________________.
cards.reviseTransitionPrompt: Revise transition: make the map-to-shelf turn clearer by adding one seed shape, drawer mark, or paper fold: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: sketch the map flap and shelf card, then write the connector between them: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: invent another seed library transition where one paper clue opens a new scene: ____________________.

cards.beforeMomentPrompt: Before moment: the rain gauge shows silver drizzle while a tiny signal card says ____________________.
cards.afterMomentPrompt: After moment: the next scene begins on the puddle platform as the conductor chooses to ____________________.

cards.characterMovePrompt: Character move: the conductor carries the story forward by checking, lifting, or turning ____________________.
cards.placeShiftPrompt: Place shift: show the scene moving from the glass gauge stand to the puddle platform by adding ____________________.
